high_level_description: The image depicts a woman walking on a cobblestone street in an urban setting. She is wearing a black, sleeveless, apron-style dress that reaches her knees. The dress has thin straps and a simple, elegant design. She is also wearing black pointed-toe heels and holding a small, dark clutch purse in her right hand. Her hair is styled in loose waves, and she appears to be looking slightly to her left. In the background, there are parked cars, including a silver SUV and a black car. The buildings behind the cars have a modern architectural style with large windows and dark facades.
